summary: Iter 41 — ScrollToTop, Marketplace filters, and Adzuna/Reed aggregator additions all working. 7/7 backend tests pass, all frontend flows pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~7240 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into feature modules (already flagged in prior iterations).

aggregators.py graceful degradation is clean: fetch_adzuna / fetch_reed log an info line and return [] when keys missing — /api/admin/aggregators/sync returned 200 with {adzuna:0, reed:0} and no traceback.
Marketplace.jsx filter logic is client-side only (useMemo). For very large listing sets this could bottleneck; server-side filtering would scale better but is not needed at current volume.
ScrollToTop.jsx correctly skips POP navigations and hash-only changes — behavior verified in both /how-it-works→/services and /marketplace→/ transitions.
